UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with rewards, diet type, health goal, food dislikes, allergies, and orders

uid.description: Unique identifier of the user matching request.auth.uid

displayName.description: User's full name or screen name

dislikes.description: List of food ingredients or items the user dislikes

allergies.description: List of allergies or dietary restrictions (e.g. Nut allergy, No onions)

rewardPoints.description: Current reward points of the user

FaqSearch.title: FaqSearch
FaqSearch.description: Logs search query terms for FAQ analytics

query.description: The search query typed by the user

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of when search occurred

resultsCount.description: Number of FAQ items found for this query

FaqFeedback.title: FaqFeedback
FaqFeedback.description: Logs helpful or not helpful click reviews for FAQs

questionId.description: The ID of the FAQ item

questionText.description: The text of the FAQ question

helpful.description: Whether the user found the answer helpful

VitalityLog.title: VitalityLog
VitalityLog.description: Daily hydration and activity tracking data for a user

date.description: Date of the log in YYYY-MM-DD format

MacroCalculatorResults.title: MacroCalculatorResults
MacroCalculatorResults.description: Computed daily caloric and macronutrient targets from macro calculator

tdee.description: Total daily energy expenditure in kcal

MealFeedback.title: MealFeedback
MealFeedback.description: Star-rating and feedback left by the user for a specific meal

mealId.description: The ID of the meal being rated

mealName.description: The name of the meal being rated

comments.description: Optional comments left by the user

userId.description: Unique identifier of the user matching request.auth.uid

userDisplayName.description: The display name of the user who left the feedback

JobApplication.title: JobApplication
JobApplication.description: Submitted application details for hiring team review

comments.description: Why applicant wants to join Taaza Bites

resumeName.description: Original file name of the resume

OrderFeedback.title: OrderFeedback
OrderFeedback.description: Star-rating for meal quality and packaging, linked to an order

orderId.description: The specific ID of the order being rated

mealName.description: The name of the meal in the order

mealRating.description: Star rating for meal quality out of 5

packagingRating.description: Star rating for packaging quality out of 5

comments.description: Optional comments left by the user

userId.description: Unique identifier of the user matching request.auth.uid

userDisplayName.description: The display name of the user who left the feedback

/job_applications/{applicationId}.description: Stores applicant submissions for careers review

/meal_feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Stores meal feedback and ratings from users for the culinary team

/order_feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Stores post-meal quality and packaging ratings for specific user orders

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles, preferences, allergies, and reward stats

/users/{userId}/vitality_logs/{date}.description: Stores user daily hydration and activity tracking data

/users/{userId}/macro_calculator/results.description: Stores computed calorie and macronutrient targets

/faq_searches/{searchId}.description: Stores user search queries for FAQ optimization analytics

/faq_feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Stores helpful/not helpful votes from visitors
